chunks: Khalid ibn Najih narrated from al-Sadiq عليه السلام that he said:
"The takbir in the adhan is to be pronounced firmly, with clear articulation of the ha' and the alif."

key_terms.التَّكْبِيرُ: the phrase of magnification, meaning saying "Allahu Akbar"
key_terms.الْأَلِفِ: the letter alif, whose pronunciation should be made clear
key_terms.الْهَاءِ: the letter ha', whose pronunciation should be made clear

ai.seo_question: How should the takbir be pronounced in the adhan according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a ruling on the proper manner of pronouncing the takbir in the adhan. It emphasizes firm delivery and clear articulation, indicating the importance of correct wording and pronunciation in acts of worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.871 - Khalid ibn Najih narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that He said: "
The takbir (saying 'Allahu Akbar') in the adhan must be pronounced firmly, with clear articulation of the 'ha' and 'alif'“.
